Overview

Verdant Reforestation

Verdant plants a forest a hectare at a time and needed a campaign that could grow with the numbers rather than shouting about them once. The system: every published asset adds one mark to a shared grid, and the grid becomes an image of the forest by year’s end.

Film, outdoor posters and social all share the same growth logic, so the campaign reads as a single accelerating gesture across every channel it touches.

A campaign should behave like the thing it is advocating for.
Creative process

Four moves, every project

  1. 01

    Core idea

    One mark per asset, accumulating into a shared yearly image.

  2. 02

    Film

    Documentary-led 60s spot following a single planting season end to end.

  3. 03

    Outdoor & print

    Poster series where each execution advances the growth grid.

  4. 04

    Social system

    Templates that let the client publish without breaking the concept.
